prompt:
Production SPRITE ATLAS for an original cute farm pixel-art game. The attached atlas is a STYLE reference only: use its warm colors, crisp dark pixel outlines, chunky readable pixel clusters, simple friendly small eyes and rounded appealing proportions. Do NOT copy the dog anatomy. Subject: ONE cute fluffy SHEEP, a compact CREAM cloud of wool with softly scalloped outline, simple PEACH FACE oval and sideways drooping PEACH EARS, tiny brown slit nostrils, brown oval split HOOVES on FOUR short clearly separated legs, small forehead curl. Sweet shy black oval eyes, small mouth. Definitely a sheep with an ovine peach muzzle, never a dog nose or puppy ears.
EXACTLY 8 ROWS x 8 COLUMNS = 64 separate whole characters on a TRUE TRANSPARENT background. Equal cells. Each animal must fit within the middle 60% of its cell with broad transparent gutters on ALL sides. No clipping, shadows, floor, labels or grid lines. Whole tail, ears, feet and wings remain inside each cell.
One genuine direction per row in this EXACT order: 1 SOUTH/front; 2 SOUTHWEST/front-left 45 degrees; 3 WEST/left PROFILE; 4 NORTHWEST/back-left 45 degrees; 5 NORTH/back; 6 NORTHEAST/back-right 45 degrees; 7 EAST/right PROFILE; 8 SOUTHEAST/front-right 45 degrees. Front and rear diagonals must visibly differ from straight front, rear and side views. Fixed 20-degree elevated orthographic camera, same physical anatomy, scale, colors and proportions for all 64 poses.
Animation across EACH row: FOUR-legged gentle sheep walk: FOUR distinguishable legs and hooves, left hind then left fore then right hind then right fore at equal quartercycle intervals, planted hooves sweep backward under stable torso, opposite pair lifted and returned. Eight evenly progressing poses, frame 5 opposite support from frame 1. A complete seamless eight-frame cycle with no repeated endpoint. Keep body center and grounded foot plane stable. Every body part is present throughout the cycle. Deliberate clean PIXEL ART, approximately 64 pixels of detail per animal, no smooth vector style, no gradients, no glossy enormous eyes. Consistent individual face and identity.
